messages:
Harper: noticed p95 drift on the latency dashboard for /v2/embeddings after the routing policy change at 11:10 UTC. chart shows a big opaque jump but per-route bars don't add up.

Zoe: can you share the window and query? my guess: emitted tdigest blobs aren't carrying sample_count so merge is unweighted.

Harper: console query is:
```sql
SELECT tdigest_percentile(tdigest_merge(td_blob), [0.95]) FROM route_tdigests WHERE endpoint='/v2/embeddings' AND window='5m'
```
We merge route blobs produced every minute.

Omar: confirmation bias: if a small route with high latencies emits an oversized tdigest (few summaries but wide tails) and we treat every tdigest equally, the global p95 will skew up even if that route handled 5% traffic.

Zoe: we should surface a "merged vs weighted" diff on the dashboard. short fix: show both numbers side-by-side and flag when difference > 15% or > 50ms.

Harper: UX note: add a hover panel listing top contributors for each percentile (route name + sample_count_in_band). engineers can triage quickly.

Omar: backend note: two paths: 1) require emitters to attach `sample_count` per tdigest blob and implement a weighted-merge routine, or 2) on read, consult router traffic logs to compute weights. option 1 is simpler and cheaper long-term.

Zoe: we'll add a console toggle "Use weighted merge (canary)" and a banner explaining when it's necessary. also add a small explanatory doc link.

Harper: runbook addition: when changing routing fractions, enable weighted-merge canary for 48h, and emit `sample_count` for the duration.

Omar: quick prototype: internal API `/internal/metrics/percentile_contribs?endpoint=/v2/embeddings&quantile=0.95&window=5m&band=0.05` that returns routes + counts as strings. can be rate-limited.

Zoe: create ticket MET-7901 to implement emitter change + console toggle. include an instrumentation test that simulates split routing and validates weighted vs unweighted agree when weights match emitted counts.

cli-bot: MET-7901 created by Zoe. Priority: P2. Link: https://redwood.example/infra/MET-7901

Harper: also suggest a small "merge sanity" health indicator on dashboards showing abs/percent delta and recent route-weight-change events. helps SREs.

Omar: will sketch backend API for the contributors endpoint and a low-cost fallback that approximates weights using router counters cached in Redis. will note accuracy caveats.

Zoe: thanks — i'll draft the console changes and doc blurb. pinging @eng-oncall to be aware when canary flips on.
